snippet.title: I Am Cat: Vacation - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Your favorite cat is going on vacation! 
Wishlist now on the Meta Store, Steam and PS Store -
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10021488
https://www.meta.com/experiences/i-am-cat-vacation/1029302159995112/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5555210/I_Am_Cat_Vacation/

Explore sunny beaches, swim with colorful fish, build sandcastles, dig for hidden treasures, and enjoy fun mini-games. 

Join Granny and her grandson for a brand-new sandbox adventure full of surprises and cat chaos!

#iamcat #iamcatvacation #vr #vrgames
